create_BaseChar: create a BaseChar with text, confidence, and polygon bounding box coordinates
create_TextChar: create a TextChar with text, confidence, and bbox_valid flag for individual character recognition
create_TextWord: create a TextWord with text, confidence, and bbox_valid flag for word-level recognition
create_TextLine: create a TextLine with text, confidence, a list of TextChar objects, and optional TextWord list
create_OCRResult: create an OCRResult containing a list of TextLine objects and image bounding box coordinates
